title: Ticket Transcripts & VoiceMaster
summary: The ticket system gained a web-based transcript viewer that renders ticket conversations as styled HTML pages. The VoiceMaster was also improved with better reliability and database usage. Ticket transcripts can now be downloaded as HTML or viewed online.

highlights.title: Web Transcript Viewer
highlights.description: Ticket transcripts are now rendered as styled HTML pages that can be viewed online. The HTML download format was also improved for better readability.

highlights.title: VoiceMaster Reliability
highlights.description: The VoiceMaster (temporary voice channels) was improved with better database usage and reliability fixes.

highlights.title: Donation Dashboard Page
highlights.description: A new customization page in the dashboard lets server admins configure donation settings without using commands.

items: Web-based ticket transcript viewer with styled HTML output
Ticket transcript database table for storing transcripts online
Dashboard customization page for donation system settings
HTML download format for ticket transcripts
VoiceMaster reliability and database usage patterns
Ticket system persistence and data handling
Ticket system data loss on restart
